question: Serve the LeRobot visualizer for my converted scissor pick-and-place dataset and show me the local URL.
ground_truth: This prompt serves an existing converted scissor_pick_and_place LeRobot dataset with tools/dataset/scripts/viz.sh <absolute dataset dir> --state-dir <dir> and reports the printed URL and stop command.
expected_behavior: uses the existing converted LeRobot dataset with meta/info.json
starts or reuses the HTML visualizer with tools/dataset/scripts/viz.sh
reports the local URL and the printed viz.sh --stop command
does not convert HDF5 as the main task

question: Open the latest converted LeRobot dataset for inspection.
ground_truth: This prompt finds the newest converted LeRobot dataset under ./runs or the LeRobot cache and serves it with tools/dataset/scripts/viz.sh.
expected_behavior: finds the latest converted LeRobot dataset by its meta/info.json
serves the dataset in the HTML visualizer
